osberghaus_2012_kinetic_sma.name: Kinetic SMA
osberghaus_2012_kinetic_sma.description: The model represents protein binding and transport during ion-exchange chromatography on a strong cation-exchange adsorbent. It predicts outlet chromatograms and retention times by combining column convection and axial dispersion, mass transfer between mobile and particle phases, and steric mass action (SMA) sorption. For the parameter-estimation study, the authors fitted an inverse mechanistic model using SMA parameters for ribonuclease A, cytochrome c, and lysozyme, and compared the results with parameters derived from gradient and breakthrough experiments. Experiments used a prepacked 1 ml column at pH 5 and pH 7, with salt gradients of several lengths and separate breakthrough runs. The authors recommend the inverse approach for chromatography process development because it predicts complete chromatograms and can support process optimization, troubleshooting, and error diagnosis.

osberghaus_2012_rapid_equilibrium_sma.name: Rapid-equilibrium SMA
osberghaus_2012_rapid_equilibrium_sma.description: The rapid-equilibrium steric mass action model represents protein binding and elution during strong cation-exchange chromatography. It predicts protein retention and outlet chromatograms by combining column transport, particle mass transfer, and SMA sorption, which represents competition between salt ions and proteins for binding capacity as well as protein shielding of binding sites. The paper compares estimating SMA parameters from gradient and breakthrough experiments with estimating them by inverse fitting of a mechanistic column model. Experiments used ribonuclease A, cytochrome c, and lysozyme on a prepacked 1 ml SP Sepharose FF column at pH 5 and pH 7. The authors use the comparison and noise analysis to assess parameter reliability and prediction, and recommend inverse fitting for process development because it predicts complete chromatograms.

facts.text: The case study models ion-exchange chromatography of ribonuclease A, cytochrome c, and lysozyme at pH 5 and pH 7.
facts.quote: These approaches for SMA parameter determination were carried out for three proteins (ribonuclease A, cytochrome c and lysozyme) at pH 5 and pH 7.

facts.text: The proteins were bovine-pancreas ribonuclease A, horse-heart cytochrome c, and chicken-egg-white lysozyme.
facts.quote: cytochrome c (horse heart), lysozyme (chicken egg white) and ribonuclease A (bovine pancreas)
